John L. Calmes Jr. as president and CEO, effective September 21, succeeding the company’s previous leadership.
Calmes most recently served as executive VP, chief financial and strategy officer, and treasurer.
He formerly worked at Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi UFJ and PwC, where he served banking and capital markets clients
Calmes said the company’s business was producing strong results through the first two and a half months of its second fiscal quarter, similar to the first quarter.

title: World Acceptance names John L. Calmes Jr. as CEO
